notes: Swaps the two purpose-built placeholder Logo components (both shipped with HAS_ASSET=false awaiting exactly this artwork) for a real lockup, and replaces the launcher icon. Fixes two live defects found while surveying: (1) SplashScreen.js rendered src/assets/images/inflx-app-icon.png, which was NOT an icon but a ChatGPT marketing-mockup screenshot carrying the heading 'Updated Mobile App Icon' and green tick bullets — shipped to every user on every launch; asset deleted and a test now fails if any <Image> returns to that screen. (2) The landing page rendered a 1536x1024 wordmark baked on SOLID BLACK at height:32px over a #070b16 hero, i.e. a black rectangle. brand-web also had no favicon resource at all. The mark is AUTO-TRACED from the founder's pixels into a 2-path SVG, not hand-drawn: the geometry has asymmetric corner radii (large top-left/bottom-right, small on the others), an oblique lean and a curved band, which a hand redraw would have got visibly wrong. Fidelity validated by rendering back and pixel-diffing the original: mean abs error 1.78/255 (<0.7%). Path data is GENERATED and must not be hand-edited. Wordmark is live text (Plus Jakarta Sans 800 web / PlusJakartaSans-Bold mobile, both already available) rather than baked pixels, so tone is a pure colour swap with no second asset to sync. The Mobile InflxMark is a deliberate duplicate of the shared one because Metro cannot resolve outside Packages/Mobile/ — same constraint already documented in src/utils/tracking.js. Icon ground was settled by review, not by delegation alone: three grounds (yellow / ink / white) were rendered at real launcher sizes and on simulated light and dark home screens. An ink tile was built first under delegated authority; the founder then reviewed the renders, restated the brand requirement (yellow mark on white background) and chose WHITE with the light-wallpaper trade-off explicitly on the table. Shipped icon is therefore the supplied artwork untouched — yellow bar, black stripe, white ground — and no border was added, since that would alter the artwork. Splash follows: white ground, navy wordmark. The splash/icon colour coupling is enforced by a test that READS values/ic_launcher_background.xml rather than restating the hex, mutation-checked by recolouring the resource alone. Reversible via GROUND in the icon generator plus that one resource. Full reasoning in 04-preview/workflow-prediction.md. Adaptive icons (mipmap-anydpi-v26) + an Android 13 monochrome layer are added; legacy PNGs stay for API 21-25. All four flavours share main/res, so one set updates agency/brand/follower/influencer. VERIFIED: pnpm qa GREEN 79 passed gate 0; Mobile jest 26 suites/115 tests (was 24/106, +9 added here); real-browser Playwright capture of the landing nav and /login with 0 page and 0 console errors; Next served /icon.png 200. Anti-fake-green: the new tests were mutation-checked — deliberately breaking the splash ground colour and the md size token failed 3 of them, then reverted. NOT VERIFIED: launcher icon and splash on a real device (artwork-only evidence). PRODUCTION-IMPACTING via THREE separate paths that are not interchangeable — brand-web to Vercel on push, Packages/Mobile/src via OTA, and android/.../res via APK REBUILD ONLY (an OTA will not move the launcher icon). No backend, no migration, no API, no schema. Explicit founder go required before push. released stays false until the founder's single end-to-end pass; Rule 5 also requires pnpm qa:maestro green before the flip.
followup_letterform: Founder request after seeing the mark live: the symbol should ACT AS the letter 'i', so the name is not spelled with two i's. Lockup goes from [mark]+'inflx' to [mark]+'nflx'. Metrics were measured two independent ways (browser Canvas TextMetrics and opentype.js glyph outlines) and agree: ascender (f/l top) 0.757em, i advance 0.260em, mark aspect 0.30378 -> mark at ascender height is 0.2299em wide vs the 0.260em i advance, so it drops into the word with 0.015em side bearings and the word keeps its natural rhythm. Founder picked Option C from a three-way study (A i-height 0.75F / B proud 0.84F / C ascender 0.76F): mark flush with f and l. SIGNIFICANT ENGINEERING CONSEQUENCE: the wordmark is now GLYPH OUTLINES (InflxLockup, 694 chars of path data), not live text. As a letter the mark's position depends on exact glyph metrics, and web loads Plus Jakarta Sans 800 while mobile bundles only Bold 700 — live text would letterfit differently per platform, and a font failing to resolve on a phone would drop the mark into the wrong place INSIDE the word. Outlines make the logotype byte-identical everywhere, fix that pre-existing 800-vs-700 inconsistency, remove the font dependency, and ship over OTA with no APK round (adding an ExtraBold TTF to mobile would have needed one). Verified the outline version reproduces the approved live-text design: same ink height (240px at ascender 120) and width within 0.9% (browser subpixel/hinting vs raw advances). Accessibility: the brand name is no longer text anywhere, so the lockup carries aria-label/accessibilityLabel 'inflx' — confirmed live on /login — with one test asserting the label and another asserting no literal 'inflx' text node survives (fails if the double-i returns). Splash caption 'Connecting Brands & Influencers' -> 'Powered by Creators, Driven by Community', both halves capitalised per founder. Applied to all 7 lockup call sites (founder chose brand-wide over splash-only); dashboard topbar (mark alone), launcher icon and favicon unaffected. Mobile Logo deliberately has no `wordmark` prop unlike the web twin — no mobile surface needs it. Verified: pnpm qa GREEN 79/79; Mobile jest 26 suites/118 tests; landing nav + /login + dashboard topbar captured on the running app with 0 page and 0 console errors. Production-impacting: brand-web via Vercel AND Packages/Mobile/src via OTA. No APK needed.

release.followup_topbar: After seeing the mark live on inflx.in/dashboard the founder asked for the top menu to drop its black strip, turn the white nav text black, and show the logo alone (slightly larger) on white. Implemented in Packages/brand-web/app/dashboard/layout.js: header #0A0A0A -> white with a #E4E4E7 rule; nav/bell #A1A1AA -> #52525B with #0A0A0A hover on #F4F4F5; unread-badge ring #0A0A0A -> white; sign-out hover white -> #0A0A0A. The active pill and avatar already used #FFC107 with #0A0A0A text and were correct on white, so were left alone. Shared Logo gained an additive `wordmark` prop (default true) so the four other call sites (landing nav, landing footer, /login, /rejected) are untouched and still render the lockup; with wordmark={false} the mark keeps its own accessible label rather than being decorative, since it is then the only thing naming the brand. NOT mirrored to Packages/Mobile — no mobile surface wants a mark-only logo and an unused prop there would force an OTA republish for zero visual change, so this follow-up is Vercel-only with no OTA. Verified: pnpm qa GREEN 79/79; dashboard captured via the QA suite's own brand-session helper with 0 page and 0 console errors; grep confirmed no QA spec pinned the old dark chrome.
